offering_evidence.statement: (“Rasayana”), pursuant to which we granted Rasayana an exclusive worldwide license with the right to grant sublicenses to research, develop, manufacture and commercialize any Product (as such term is defined in the Rasayana License Agreement), which includes SYN-020, comprising, containing, or covered by the Licensed IP (as such term is defined in the Rasayana License Agreement) and/or devised, developed, or produced using the Licensed IP.

As part of our strategic transformation into an oncology focused company, we (i) entered into the Rasayana License Agreement with Rasayana in February 2026, pursuant to which we granted Rasayana an exclusive worldwide license to research, develop, manufacture and commercialize any product related to or deriving from our SYN-020 asset, and (ii) we are exploring value creation options for our SYN - 004 asset, including out - licensing or partnering as we do not intend to further develop SYN-004 without receipt of grant funding or funding through a partnership or other collaboration.

Commercial quantities of any drugs we seek to develop will have to be manufactured in facilities and by processes that comply with the FDA and other regulations, and we plan to rely on third parties to manufacture commercial quantities of products we successfully develop through FDA approval.

In addition, we are entitled to receive from Rasayana development milestone payments of up to an aggregate of $16.0 million and sales milestone payments of up to an aggregate of $22.0 million upon achievement of certain development and net sales milestones with respect to Products.

On February 17, 2026, we entered into the Rasayana License Agreement with Rasayana, pursuant to which we granted Rasayana an exclusive worldwide license with the right to grant sublicenses to research, develop, manufacture and commercialize any Product (as such term is defined in the Rasayana License Agreement), which includes SYN-020, comprising, containing, or covered by the Licensed IP (as such term is defined in the Rasayana License Agreement) and/or devised, developed, or produced using the Licensed IP.

On February 17, 2026, we entered into the Rasayana License Agreement with Rasayana, whereby we granted Rasayana an exclusive worldwide license with the right to grant sublicenses to research, develop, manufacture and commercialize any Product (as such term is defined in the Rasayana License Agreement), which includes SYN-020, comprising, containing, or covered by the Licensed IP (as such term is defined in the Rasayana License Agreement) and/or devised, developed, or produced using the Licensed IP.
Our product candidates SYN-004 and SYN-020 are biologics that can be readily synthesized by processes that we have developed;
The manufacturing process must conform to consistency and quality standards, and we must develop methods for testing the quality, purity, and potency of the final products.

Under the terms of the CTA, we will serve as the sponsor of the Study and supply SYN-004 (ribaxamase), as well as compensate Washington University for all research services to be provided in connection with the Study which is estimated to cost approximately $3,200,000.
We do not own or operate manufacturing facilities for the production of our product candidates, but we do produce and test viruses and virus processes at our facilities in Spain.
We do not own or operate manufacturing facilities for the production of these product candidates for preclinical and clinical activities.
We plan to rely on third parties to manufacture commercial quantities of products that we successfully develop through regulatory approval.
